about_the_game:
Of The Lilies is a visual novel-style romantic adventure game about love, loss, and sacrifice. Explore a fantasy colonial world together with your love interest in 5 different routes, and reach 15 different endings by deciding if your own motives over the greater good is worth a single sacrifice.

As the chieftain-to-be in the small village of Tayabac, your family was counting on you to lead the tribe and take care of your people. But when your hometown is invaded by the Seiyslan Empire, you’re left without a home, without a culture, and without a family.

You were saved by Lady Sabina, who brought you into her home, with the condition that you join an organization that keeps the Seiyslan people safe. You'll have the chance to meet 5 love interests along the way: Seiji—your protective best friend, Myo—the charming rebel leader, Taji—your mysterious rival, Laisa—a cunning pirate, and Lien—the conqueror who separated you from your family.

10 years later, when the curses that come only once a century resurface, you are tasked to protect the Seiyslan Empire, the very people that took everything away from you, and are faced with a choice that forces you to decide on the path you’re willing to take to come to terms with your past. Who are you willing to sacrifice?

Choose Your Main Character

Customize your name, pronouns, and choose the main character you play as (female, non-binary, or male).

5 Romanceable Routes: Who Will You Sacrifice?

Of The Lilies features 5 love interests, each with their own views and personal stories. Get to know the characters and form bonds that may last or falter in the face of conflict.

Choices Matter, Multiple Endings

Your choices determine how your story ends, with 15 different endings. Choose based on what you believe is right as you confront your past and resolve your inner conflict.

Explore the World of Ambana

Immerse yourself in a fantasy world inspired by Southeast Asian culture and history. Discover more about the stories behind the people and explore the rich lore that shaped the society you live in.

Mini Games

Combat enemies, brew potions, and more through mini games woven into your story.
